finding: All four intended package interactions reproduced on discovery and held-out controlled matrices, and all twelve cross-package interactions stayed below target. The first independent-policy panel then rejected the exact combination: none of the four packages met the frozen activation gate, Ash poison added one non-win, and Dusk ward-mirror increased combat duration while producing only six policy witnesses. No whole-run, detector or protected-seed work was permitted after that decisive failure.
limits: This is a bounded negative for candidate content d1e725734176ed9dde0d7712fa5bb9c11142847277b9664a821053b6d63f88b5 and its frozen pilot/protocol only.

The panel also showed that capped total combat damage is a poor activation response when every arm wins; any successor experiment must preregister a mechanism-level response rather than reinterpret these rows.
No protected acceptance or reserve seed was used.
